title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
title_zh: OccJEPA：将遮挡作为掩码的amodal视频分割

paragraphs.en: 将遮挡视为掩码，用预训练V-JEPA预测器填补生成amodal掩码，比扩散方法快33.5倍且更准确。 Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.
paragraphs.zh: 将遮挡视为掩码，用预训练V-JEPA预测器填补生成amodal掩码，比扩散方法快33.5倍且更准确。Amodal视频分割要求得到物体在每一帧中的完整掩码，包括被其他物体遮挡的部分。 目前最好的方法使用微调后的视频扩散模型来生成这些掩码，这类模型需要大量去噪步骤和一个额外的深度网络，且每次采样的结果都不相同。 JEPA系列的自监督视频世界模型是在一个密切相关的任务上训练的：从可见的时空区域预测被掩码区域的表征。 因此，我们将遮挡视为掩码处理。 物体可见掩码未覆盖的token被丢弃，由预训练的V-JEPA 2.1预测器将其填补，再由一个轻量级解码头将观测到的和预测的特征解码为amodal掩码。 由此得到的模型OccJEPA（Occlusion-as-masking JEPA，遮挡即掩码JEPA）是确定性的，比基于扩散的最先进方法快33.5倍，并且在SAIL-VOS、TAO-Amodal（包括一个留出的测试集划分，+4.00 AP50）以及由SAM2跟踪的可见掩码上，还有Kubric上都更加准确。 受控实验表明，性能提升源于预测器的预训练权重而非其容量，这一结论在参数量从87M到1.85B的世界模型上均成立。 代码可在 https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa 获取。
